follow-up time: 4.6 years for children born after PGT, 9.0 years for children born after IVF/ICSI, and 5.1 years for children born after spontaneous conception
cohort: This study included all singletons born after PGT (n = 390) in Sweden during 1 January 1996-30 September 2019, compared with all singletons born after IVF/ICSI (n = 61,060) and a matched sample of singletons born after spontaneous conception (n = 42,034) during the same period.
finding: Children born after PGT had comparable perinatal outcomes to children born after IVF/ICSI and spontaneous conception, with no significant differences in early childhood health outcomes.
